issues.description: The problem statement requires Book.author to be a String (the author's name), but the solution implementation declares Book.author as Bool. The Client implementation and assembleBookstore construct and print author values as Strings, so the Bool type in the Book struct is inconsistent and will break compilation and confuse students about the intended type.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the type of Book.author from Bool to String in the Book struct (and ensure it is declared as a let constant). Update the template and solution Book struct signature to: let author: String so it matches the problem statement and the Client usage. Ensure all places constructing Books use String for the author parameter.
